basics.name: Cecil Sithole
basics.summary: I am a double cum laude graduate with an honors degree in Information Systems and a full-stack software developer with three years of hands-on experience. Currently a graduate at BMW, I specialize in web development, database design, cloud computing, and API integration. I have experience in software development and Driving Assistant Functions testing (FAS), as well as AWS system migration and production tracking optimization.

items.summary: Key role in digitization and innovation, focusing on software development and Driving Assistant Functions testing (FAS) for the new X3 model.
Contributed to system migration to AWS and dashboard development for X3-G45 tracking; optimized production insights through Oracle and Qlik Sense.
